items.title: AMETEK (AME) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Q3 Beat And Indicor Deal
items.summary: AMETEK’s updated valuation work now points to a fair value of about US$284.72, compared with roughly US$278.33 in the prior framework. Recent analyst commentary around the Q3 2026 beat, organic order growth of 17%, and the closing of the US$5b Indicor acquisition helps explain why price targets are clustering higher, even as many firms keep more balanced ratings.
